findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There were dirty dishes observed in the basin of the handwashing sink. The dishes were removed and placed inside of the ware washing sink to correct the violation. Ensure that the handwashing sink remains unobstructed to allow easy access for employees to wash hands.
findings.citation_text: 5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were raw beef patties stored above ready to eat foods inside of the main cooler. The RTE foods included veggies, sauces, and cheeses. Discussed with the PIC and the beef was moved to the bottom shelf of the cooler to correct the violation. Ensure that raw meats are always stored beneath RTE foods to protect against contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.
